purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (ORCRDPC10) that creates/edits DPC (receipt/claim) files for a Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system, specifically handling admission (入院) receipt data. It reads and writes multiple indexed files (RECE62, RECE641, RECE65, RECE68, RECE69, RECE900) corresponding to receipt detail, admission history, and sequence number data, and produces an error file.
